### `artifacts/api-server/src/wings/services/overrides.ts`

```typescript
import { and, eq, inArray, isNotNull, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import {
  db,
  jobsTable,
  invoicesTable,
  wingAssignmentsTable,
  wingMembersTable,
  wingOverridesTable,
  wingReserveAccountsTable,
  wingReserveTxnsTable,
  wingQualitySubmissionsTable,
} from "@workspace/db";
import { calculateOverride } from "../core/override-engine";
import { decimalToCents, centsToDecimal, monthsBetween } from "../core/math";
import { getWingConfig } from "./config";
import { logWingAudit } from "./audit";

/** A job's revenue counts as collected when it has invoices, none unpaid. */
async function collectedAtForJob(jobId: string): Promise<Date | null> {
  const invoices = await db
    .select()
    .from(invoicesTable)
    .where(eq(invoicesTable.jobId, jobId));
  const real = invoices.filter((i) => i.status !== "draft");
  if (!real.length) return null;
  if (real.some((i) => i.status !== "paid")) return null;
  const paidDates = real
    .map((i) => i.paidAt)
    .filter((d): d is Date => d != null);
  if (!paidDates.length) return null;
  return new Date(Math.max(...paidDates.map((d) => d.getTime())));
}

export async function createJobOverrideAccruals(jobId: string) {
  const [job] = await db.select().from(jobsTable).where(eq(jobsTable.id, jobId));
  if (!job) throw new Error("Job not found.");
  if (job.grossProfit == null) {
    throw new Error("Overrides require computed gross profit.");
  }
  const collectedAt = await collectedAtForJob(jobId);
  if (!collectedAt) {
    throw new Error("Overrides require fully collected payment.");
  }
  const [submission] = await db
    .select()
    .from(wingQualitySubmissionsTable)
    .where(eq(wingQualitySubmissionsTable.jobId, jobId));
  if (!submission || submission.reviewStatus !== "PASS") {
    throw new Error("Overrides require a passed quality review.");
  }

  const config = await getWingConfig();
  const grossProfitCents = decimalToCents(job.grossProfit);
  if (grossProfitCents < config.overrides.minimumGrossProfitCents) return [];

  const assignments = await db
    .select()
    .from(wingAssignmentsTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(wingAssignmentsTable.jobId, jobId),
        isNotNull(wingAssignmentsTable.completedAt),
      ),
    );
  if (!assignments.length) return [];
  const totalWeight = assignments.reduce(
    (sum, a) => sum + Math.max(0, a.profitShareWeight),
    0,
  );
  if (totalWeight <= 0) return [];

  const members = await db
    .select()
    .from(wingMembersTable)
    .where(
      inArray(
        wingMembersTable.crewId,
        assignments.map((a) => a.crewId),
      ),
    );

  const created: (typeof wingOverridesTable.$inferSelect)[] = [];
  for (const assignment of assignments) {
    const recruit = members.find((m) => m.crewId === assignment.crewId);
    if (!recruit?.sponsorCrewId) continue;
    // Approval gate: both recruit and sponsor must be approved members.
    if (recruit.membershipStatus !== "ACTIVE") continue;
    const sponsorMember = await db
      .select({ membershipStatus: wingMembersTable.membershipStatus })
      .from(wingMembersTable)
      .where(eq(wingMembersTable.crewId, recruit.sponsorCrewId));
    if (sponsorMember[0]?.membershipStatus !== "ACTIVE") continue;
    const sponsorCrewId = recruit.sponsorCrewId;

    const allocatedCents = Math.round(
      grossProfitCents * (Math.max(0, assignment.profitShareWeight) / totalWeight),
    );
    const relationshipMonths = monthsBetween(
      recruit.sponsorSince ?? recruit.createdAt,
      collectedAt,
    );
    const override = calculateOverride(
      {
        allocatedGrossProfitCents: allocatedCents,
        sponsorRelationshipMonths: relationshipMonths,
        recruitHaloScore: recruit.haloScore,
        reservePercent: config.overrides.reservePercent,
      },
      config,
    );
    if (override.grossOverrideCents <= 0) continue;

    const qualityWindowEndsAt = new Date(
      collectedAt.getTime() +
        config.quality.defaultQualityWindowDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
    );

    const row = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const inserted = await tx
        .insert(wingOverridesTable)
        .values({
          jobId,
          sponsorCrewId,
          recruitCrewId: recruit.crewId,
          allocatedGrossProfit: allocatedCents / 100,
          baseRate: override.baseRate,
          qualityMultiplier: override.qualityMultiplier,
          grossOverride: override.grossOverrideCents / 100,
          immediateAmount: override.immediateAmountCents / 100,
          reserveAmount: override.reserveAmountCents / 100,
          status: "HELD",
          immediateStatus: "READY",
          qualityWindowEndsAt,
        })
        .onConflictDoNothing()
        .returning();
      if (!inserted.length) return null; // Already accrued: idempotent retry.
      const record = inserted[0];

      const [account] = await tx
        .insert(wingReserveAccountsTable)
        .values({
          crewId: sponsorCrewId,
          heldBalance: override.reserveAmountCents / 100,
        })
        .onConflictDoUpdate({
          target: wingReserveAccountsTable.crewId,
          set: {
            heldBalance: sql`${wingReserveAccountsTable.heldBalance} + ${override.reserveAmountCents / 100}`,
          },
        })
        .returning();

      await tx.insert(wingReserveTxnsTable).values({
        accountId: account.id,
        crewId: sponsorCrewId,
        overrideId: record.id,
        type: "HOLD",
        amount: override.reserveAmountCents / 100,
        balanceAfter: account.heldBalance,
        note: `Guardian Reserve hold for job ${job.jobNo}.`,
      });

      return record;
    });

    if (row) {
      await logWingAudit({
        action: "OVERRIDE_ACCRUED",
        entityType: "wing_override",
        entityId: row.id,
        after: {
          baseRate: override.baseRate,
          qualityMultiplier: override.qualityMultiplier,
          grossOverrideCents: override.grossOverrideCents,
          immediateAmountCents: override.immediateAmountCents,
          reserveAmountCents: override.reserveAmountCents,
        },
        reason: `Completed, collected, quality-approved recruit work on job ${job.jobNo}. Payout-ready entry created; money moves only through HALO's normal crew payment flow.`,
      });
      created.push(row);
    }
  }
  return created;
}

/** Sweep: accrue overrides for any eligible jobs that don't have them yet. */
export async function accrueReadyJobOverrides(maxJobs: number): Promise<number> {
  const passed = await db
    .select({ jobId: wingQualitySubmissionsTable.jobId })
    .from(wingQualitySubmissionsTable)
    .where(eq(wingQualitySubmissionsTable.reviewStatus, "PASS"));
  let processed = 0;
  for (const { jobId } of passed.slice(0, maxJobs)) {
    try {
      const created = await createJobOverrideAccruals(jobId);
      if (created.length) processed += 1;
    } catch {
      // Not collected yet or no sponsored recruits; retried next run.
    }
  }
  return processed;
}
```


### `artifacts/api-server/src/wings/services/quality.ts`

```typescript
import { and, eq, inArray, isNotNull } from "drizzle-orm";
import {
  db,
  jobsTable,
  crewPhotosTable,
  wingQualitySubmissionsTable,
  wingQualityReviewsTable,
} from "@workspace/db";
import { ObjectStorageService } from "../../lib/objectStorage";
import { logger } from "../../lib/logger";
import {
  reviewQualityEvidence,
  type EvidenceImage,
} from "../ai/reviewer";
import { getWingConfig } from "./config";
import { logWingAudit } from "./audit";
import { createJobOverrideAccruals } from "./overrides";

/**
 * Idempotent sweep: every completed job gets exactly one quality submission
 * built from the job's before/after photo activities. Jobs with no photo
 * evidence are routed straight to NEEDS_REVIEW (never auto-failed).
 */
export async function ensureQualitySubmissions(): Promise<number> {
  const jobs = await db
    .select()
    .from(jobsTable)
    .where(
      and(
        inArray(jobsTable.status, ["complete", "closed"]),
        isNotNull(jobsTable.completedAt),
        isNotNull(jobsTable.crewLeaderId),
      ),
    );
  if (!jobs.length) return 0;
  const jobIds = jobs.map((j) => j.id);
  const existing = await db
    .select({ jobId: wingQualitySubmissionsTable.jobId })
    .from(wingQualitySubmissionsTable)
    .where(inArray(wingQualitySubmissionsTable.jobId, jobIds));
  const have = new Set(existing.map((e) => e.jobId));
  const missing = jobs.filter((j) => !have.has(j.id));
  if (!missing.length) return 0;

  const photos = await db
    .select()
    .from(crewPhotosTable)
    .where(
      inArray(
        crewPhotosTable.jobId,
        missing.map((j) => j.id),
      ),
    );

  let created = 0;
  for (const job of missing) {
    const jobPhotos = photos.filter((p) => p.jobId === job.id && p.storagePath);
    const before = jobPhotos
      .filter((p) => p.phase === "before")
      .map((p) => p.storagePath);
    const after = jobPhotos
      .filter((p) => p.phase === "after")
      .map((p) => p.storagePath);
    const hasEvidence = before.length > 0 || after.length > 0;
    await db
      .insert(wingQualitySubmissionsTable)
      .values({
        jobId: job.id,
        crewId: job.crewLeaderId,
        beforePaths: before,
        afterPaths: after,
        reviewStatus: hasEvidence ? "PENDING" : "NEEDS_REVIEW",
        notes: hasEvidence
          ? null
          : "No photo evidence found for this job. Routed to human review.",
      })
      .onConflictDoNothing();
    if (!hasEvidence) {
      await logWingAudit({
        action: "QUALITY_ESCALATED_NO_EVIDENCE",
        entityType: "job",
        entityId: job.id,
        reason:
          "Job completed without photo evidence; escalated to human review instead of penalizing the crew.",
      });
    }
    created += 1;
  }
  return created;
}

async function loadImage(
  storagePath: string,
  stage: "BEFORE" | "AFTER",
): Promise<EvidenceImage | null> {
  try {
    const svc = new ObjectStorageService();
    const file = await svc.getObjectEntityFile(storagePath);
    const [meta] = await file.getMetadata();
    const contentType = String(meta.contentType || "image/jpeg");
    const mediaType = (
      ["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp"].includes(contentType)
        ? contentType
        : "image/jpeg"
    ) as EvidenceImage["mediaType"];
    const [buffer] = await file.download();
    if (buffer.length > 4.5 * 1024 * 1024) return null;
    return { stage, base64: buffer.toString("base64"), mediaType };
  } catch (err) {
    logger.warn(`wings: failed to load evidence image ${storagePath}: ${err}`);
    return null;
  }
}

export async function reviewQualitySubmission(submissionId: string) {
  const [submission] = await db
    .select()
    .from(wingQualitySubmissionsTable)
    .where(eq(wingQualitySubmissionsTable.id, submissionId));
  if (!submission) throw new Error("Submission not found.");
  const [existingReview] = await db
    .select()
    .from(wingQualityReviewsTable)
    .where(eq(wingQualityReviewsTable.submissionId, submissionId));
  if (existingReview) return existingReview;

  const [job] = await db
    .select()
    .from(jobsTable)
    .where(eq(jobsTable.id, submission.jobId));
  if (!job) throw new Error("Job not found for submission.");

  const config = await getWingConfig();
  const beforePaths = (submission.beforePaths as string[] | null) ?? [];
  const afterPaths = (submission.afterPaths as string[] | null) ?? [];
  const images = (
    await Promise.all([
      ...beforePaths.map((p) => loadImage(p, "BEFORE" as const)),
      ...afterPaths.map((p) => loadImage(p, "AFTER" as const)),
    ])
  ).filter((img): img is EvidenceImage => img != null);

  if (!images.length) {
    await db
      .update(wingQualitySubmissionsTable)
      .set({ reviewStatus: "NEEDS_REVIEW" })
      .where(eq(wingQualitySubmissionsTable.id, submissionId));
    return null;
  }

  const ai = await reviewQualityEvidence({
    job: {
      name: `${job.jobNo} — ${job.category ?? "Job"}`,
      description: job.description,
    },
    notes: submission.notes,
    images,
    maxImages: config.quality.maxImagesPerReview,
  });

  const weightedScore =
    ai.completenessScore * 0.35 +
    ai.craftsmanshipScore * 0.35 +
    ai.propertyProtectionScore * 0.15 +
    ai.safetyScore * 0.15;

  let finalStatus = "NEEDS_REVIEW";
  if (
    ai.recommendedStatus === "PASS" &&
    ai.confidence >= config.quality.autoPassConfidence &&
    !ai.criticalConcern &&
    ai.anomalyRisk < 0.35
  ) {
    finalStatus = "PASS";
  } else if (
    ai.recommendedStatus === "FAIL" &&
    ai.criticalConcern &&
    config.quality.autoFailCritical &&
    ai.confidence >= 0.9
  ) {
    finalStatus = "FAIL";
  }

  const [review] = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const inserted = await tx
      .insert(wingQualityReviewsTable)
      .values({
        submissionId,
        status: finalStatus,
        finalScore: Math.round(weightedScore * 100) / 100,
        completenessScore: ai.completenessScore,
        craftsmanshipScore: ai.craftsmanshipScore,
        propertyProtectionScore: ai.propertyProtectionScore,
        safetyScore: ai.safetyScore,
        anomalyRisk: ai.anomalyRisk,
        confidence: ai.confidence,
        criticalConcern: ai.criticalConcern,
        summary: ai.summary,
        concerns: ai.concerns,
        evidence: ai.evidence,
        aiModel: "claude-sonnet-4-6",
        decidedBy: "AI",
      })
      .onConflictDoNothing()
      .returning();
    await tx
      .update(wingQualitySubmissionsTable)
      .set({ reviewStatus: finalStatus })
      .where(eq(wingQualitySubmissionsTable.id, submissionId));
    return inserted;
  });

  await logWingAudit({
    actorType: "AI",
    action: "QUALITY_EVIDENCE_REVIEWED",
    entityType: "quality_submission",
    entityId: submissionId,
    after: {
      status: finalStatus,
      score: weightedScore,
      confidence: ai.confidence,
      criticalConcern: ai.criticalConcern,
      concerns: ai.concerns,
    },
    reason: ai.summary,
  });

  if (finalStatus === "PASS") {
    await createJobOverrideAccruals(submission.jobId).catch(() => {});
  }
  return review ?? null;
}

export async function decideQualitySubmission(input: {
  submissionId: string;
  status: "PASS" | "FAIL" | "NEEDS_REVIEW";
  reason: string;
  finalScore?: number;
}) {
  const [submission] = await db
    .select()
    .from(wingQualitySubmissionsTable)
    .where(eq(wingQualitySubmissionsTable.id, input.submissionId));
  if (!submission) throw new Error("Submission not found.");
  const [existing] = await db
    .select()
    .from(wingQualityReviewsTable)
    .where(eq(wingQualityReviewsTable.submissionId, input.submissionId));
  const score = Math.max(
    0,
    Math.min(100, input.finalScore ?? existing?.finalScore ?? 0),
  );

  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    if (existing) {
      await tx
        .update(wingQualityReviewsTable)
        .set({
          status: input.status,
          finalScore: score,
          summary: input.reason,
          decidedBy: "ADMIN",
          reviewedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(wingQualityReviewsTable.submissionId, input.submissionId));
    } else {
      await tx.insert(wingQualityReviewsTable).values({
        submissionId: input.submissionId,
        status: input.status,
        finalScore: score,
        completenessScore: score,
        craftsmanshipScore: score,
        propertyProtectionScore: score,
        safetyScore: score,
        anomalyRisk: 0,
        confidence: 1,
        criticalConcern: input.status === "FAIL",
        summary: input.reason,
        concerns: input.status === "PASS" ? [] : [input.reason],
        evidence: { manualDecision: true },
        decidedBy: "ADMIN",
      });
    }
    await tx
      .update(wingQualitySubmissionsTable)
      .set({ reviewStatus: input.status })
      .where(eq(wingQualitySubmissionsTable.id, input.submissionId));
  });

  await logWingAudit({
    actorType: "ADMIN",
    action: "QUALITY_DECISION_OVERRIDDEN",
    entityType: "quality_submission",
    entityId: input.submissionId,
    before: existing
      ? { status: existing.status, finalScore: existing.finalScore }
      : undefined,
    after: { status: input.status, finalScore: score },
    reason: input.reason,
  });

  if (input.status === "PASS") {
    await createJobOverrideAccruals(submission.jobId).catch(() => {});
  }
}
```

### `artifacts/api-server/src/wings/services/reserve.ts`

```typescript
import { and, eq, lte } from "drizzle-orm";
import {
  db,
  jobsTable,
  wingIncidentsTable,
  wingOverridesTable,
  wingReserveAccountsTable,
  wingReserveTxnsTable,
} from "@workspace/db";
import { settleGuardianReserve } from "../core/guardian-reserve";
import { decimalToCents } from "../core/math";
import { getWingConfig } from "./config";
import { logWingAudit } from "./audit";

const BLOCKING_TYPES = ["CALLBACK", "REWORK", "DAMAGE", "CUSTOMER_COMPLAINT"];

export async function settleDueGuardianReserves(now = new Date()) {
  const config = await getWingConfig();
  const due = await db
    .select()
    .from(wingOverridesTable)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(wingOverridesTable.status, "HELD"),
        lte(wingOverridesTable.qualityWindowEndsAt, now),
      ),
    );

  const results: Array<{ overrideId: string; status: string }> = [];
  for (const accrual of due) {
    const incidents = await db
      .select()
      .from(wingIncidentsTable)
      .where(eq(wingIncidentsTable.jobId, accrual.jobId));

    const unresolved = incidents.filter(
      (i) => BLOCKING_TYPES.includes(i.type) && !i.resolvedAt,
    );
    if (unresolved.length) {
      results.push({
        overrideId: accrual.id,
        status: "WAITING_ON_INCIDENT_RESOLUTION",
      });
      continue;
    }

    // Only incidents linked to the applicable recruit create automatic debits.
    const eligibleReworkCostCents = incidents
      .filter(
        (i) =>
          i.crewId === accrual.recruitCrewId &&
          ["CALLBACK", "REWORK", "DAMAGE"].includes(i.type),
      )
      .reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.cost ? decimalToCents(i.cost) : 0), 0);

    const settlement = settleGuardianReserve({
      reserveAmountCents: decimalToCents(accrual.reserveAmount),
      eligibleReworkCostCents,
      qualityBonusPercent: config.overrides.qualityBonusPercentOfReserve,
    });

    let settled = false;
    await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      // Concurrency guard: claim the override while it is still HELD. If a
      // parallel sweep already settled it, this returns no rows and we skip.
      const claimed = await tx
        .update(wingOverridesTable)
        .set({
          status: settlement.debitCents > 0 ? "ADJUSTED" : "AVAILABLE",
          reserveBonus: settlement.bonusCents / 100,
          reserveDebit: settlement.debitCents / 100,
          reserveReleasedAt: now,
        })
        .where(
          and(
            eq(wingOverridesTable.id, accrual.id),
            eq(wingOverridesTable.status, "HELD"),
          ),
        )
        .returning({ id: wingOverridesTable.id });
      if (!claimed.length) return;

      const [account] = await tx
        .select()
        .from(wingReserveAccountsTable)
        .where(eq(wingReserveAccountsTable.crewId, accrual.sponsorCrewId));
      if (!account) throw new Error("Reserve account missing.");
      const heldCents = Math.max(
        0,
        decimalToCents(account.heldBalance) -
          decimalToCents(accrual.reserveAmount),
      );
      const releasedCents =
        decimalToCents(account.releasedBalance) + settlement.totalAvailableCents;
      const debitedCents =
        decimalToCents(account.debitedBalance) + settlement.debitCents;

      await tx
        .update(wingReserveAccountsTable)
        .set({
          heldBalance: heldCents / 100,
          releasedBalance: releasedCents / 100,
          debitedBalance: debitedCents / 100,
        })
        .where(eq(wingReserveAccountsTable.id, account.id));

      const txns: Array<{ type: string; amount: number; note: string }> = [];
      if (settlement.debitCents > 0)
        txns.push({
          type: "REWORK_DEBIT",
          amount: -settlement.debitCents / 100,
          note: "Guardian Reserve quality adjustment for verified corrective work.",
        });
      if (settlement.releaseCents > 0)
        txns.push({
          type: "RELEASE",
          amount: settlement.releaseCents / 100,
          note: "Guardian Reserve released after the quality window.",
        });
      if (settlement.bonusCents > 0)
        txns.push({
          type: "QUALITY_BONUS",
          amount: settlement.bonusCents / 100,
          note: "No-callback Quality Kicker.",
        });
      for (const t of txns) {
        await tx.insert(wingReserveTxnsTable).values({
          accountId: account.id,
          crewId: accrual.sponsorCrewId,
          overrideId: accrual.id,
          type: t.type,
          amount: t.amount,
          balanceAfter: heldCents / 100,
          note: t.note,
        });
      }

      settled = true;
    });

    if (!settled) {
      results.push({ overrideId: accrual.id, status: "ALREADY_SETTLED" });
      continue;
    }

    await logWingAudit({
      action: "GUARDIAN_RESERVE_SETTLED",
      entityType: "wing_override",
      entityId: accrual.id,
      after: settlement,
      reason:
        settlement.debitCents > 0
          ? "Verified corrective work existed."
          : "Quality window passed without eligible rework cost.",
    });
    results.push({ overrideId: accrual.id, status: "SETTLED" });
  }
  return results;
}
```


## 5. Database Schema


### `lib/db/src/index.ts`

```typescript
import { drizzle } from "drizzle-orm/node-postgres";
import pg from "pg";
import * as schema from "./schema";

const { Pool } = pg;

if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) {
  throw new Error(
    "DATABASE_URL must be set. Did you forget to provision a database?",
  );
}

export const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });
export const db = drizzle(pool, { schema });

export * from "./schema";
```


### `lib/db/src/schema/activity.ts`

```typescript
import {
  pgTable,
  uuid,
  text,
  jsonb,
  timestamp,
  uniqueIndex,
} from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";

export const notificationsTable = pgTable("notifications", {
  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  kind: text("kind").notNull(),
  priority: text("priority").notNull().default("normal"),
  entityType: text("entity_type"),
  entityId: text("entity_id"),
  title: text("title").notNull(),
  body: text("body"),
  sentAt: timestamp("sent_at", { withTimezone: true }).defaultNow(),
  readAt: timestamp("read_at", { withTimezone: true }),
  resolvedAt: timestamp("resolved_at", { withTimezone: true }),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true })
    .notNull()
    .defaultNow(),
});

export const activitiesTable = pgTable("activities", {
  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  entityType: text("entity_type").notNull(),
  entityId: text("entity_id").notNull(),
  kind: text("kind").notNull(),
  body: text("body"),
  storagePath: text("storage_path"),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true })
    .notNull()
    .defaultNow(),
});

export const voiceLogsTable = pgTable("voice_logs", {
  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  transcript: text("transcript").notNull(),
  actions: jsonb("actions"),
  appliedAt: timestamp("applied_at", { withTimezone: true }),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true })
    .notNull()
    .defaultNow(),
});

// Actions the Autopilot proposes (and, when auto-approve is on, executes).
// status: pending -> executing -> executed | failed, or pending -> dismissed
export const autopilotActionsTable = pgTable(
  "autopilot_actions",
  {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    kind: text("kind").notNull(),
    entityType: text("entity_type").notNull(),
    entityId: text("entity_id").notNull(),
    title: text("title").notNull(),
    body: text("body").notNull(),
    payload: jsonb("payload"),
    status: text("status").notNull().default("pending"),
    result: text("result"),
    executedAt: timestamp("executed_at", { withTimezone: true }),
    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true })
      .notNull()
      .defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [uniqueIndex("autopilot_actions_kind_entity_uq").on(t.kind, t.entityId)],
);

// Feed items the owner has manually cleared from the Today feed.
// itemId matches the deterministic FeedItem id (e.g. "inv-<uuid>").
export const feedDismissalsTable = pgTable(
  "feed_dismissals",
  {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    itemId: text("item_id").notNull(),
    dismissedAt: timestamp("dismissed_at", { withTimezone: true })
      .notNull()
      .defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [uniqueIndex("feed_dismissals_item_uq").on(t.itemId)],
);

export type FeedDismissal = typeof feedDismissalsTable.$inferSelect;
export type AutopilotAction = typeof autopilotActionsTable.$inferSelect;
export type Notification = typeof notificationsTable.$inferSelect;
export type Activity = typeof activitiesTable.$inferSelect;
export type VoiceLog = typeof voiceLogsTable.$inferSelect;
```

```typescript
  invoiceId: uuid("invoice_id"),
  amount: doublePrecision("amount").notNull(),
  method: text("method"),
  payerName: text("payer_name"),
  checkNumber: text("check_number"),
  checkImagePath: text("check_image_path"),
  receivedAt: timestamp("received_at", { withTimezone: true })
    .notNull()
    .defaultNow(),
});

export const expensesTable = pgTable("expenses", {
  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  jobId: uuid("job_id"),
  propertyId: uuid("property_id"),
  vendor: text("vendor"),
  category: text("category"),
  amount: doublePrecision("amount").notNull(),
  source: text("source"),
  paymentStatus: text("payment_status").notNull().default("paid"),
  dueDate: date("due_date", { mode: "string" }),
  paidAt: timestamp("paid_at", { withTimezone: true }),
  receiptPath: text("receipt_path"),
  approvalStatus: text("approval_status").notNull().default("approved"),
  approvedAt: timestamp("approved_at", { withTimezone: true }),
  bankTxnId: text("bank_txn_id"),
  bankTxnLabel: text("bank_txn_label"),
  spentOn: timestamp("spent_on", { withTimezone: true })
    .notNull()
    .defaultNow(),
});

export type Invoice = typeof invoicesTable.$inferSelect;
export type InvoiceLineItem = typeof invoiceLineItemsTable.$inferSelect;
export type Payment = typeof paymentsTable.$inferSelect;
export type Expense = typeof expensesTable.$inferSelect;
```

```typescript
import {
  pgTable,
  uuid,
  text,
  jsonb,
  timestamp,
} from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";

/**
 * A Welcome Kit onboarding packet sent to a crew. One row per send.
 * Status flow: sent -> in_progress -> submitted.
 */
export const crewPacketsTable = pgTable("crew_packets", {
  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  crewId: uuid("crew_id").notNull(),
  templateKey: text("template_key").notNull(),
  status: text("status").notNull().default("sent"),
  /** { insured: boolean, ach: boolean } */
  applicability: jsonb("applicability"),
  /** { [formCode]: { [fieldKey]: value } } */
  formsData: jsonb("forms_data"),
  /** { [formCode]: SignatureValue } */
  signatures: jsonb("signatures"),
  /** { [formCode]: PacketAttachmentValue[] } */
  attachments: jsonb("attachments"),
  sentAt: timestamp("sent_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  submittedAt: timestamp("submitted_at", { withTimezone: true }),
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true })
    .notNull()
    .defaultNow(),
});

export type CrewPacket = typeof crewPacketsTable.$inferSelect;
```

```typescript
import { boolean, doublePrecision, pgTable, uuid, text, timestamp } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";

export const businessSettingsTable = pgTable("business_settings", {
  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
  companyName: text("company_name").notNull().default("ArchAngel Contractors"),
  tagline: text("tagline").notNull().default("Restoration & Make-Ready"),
  street: text("street").notNull().default("130 N Preston Rd, Suite 334"),
  city: text("city").notNull().default("Prosper, TX 75078"),
  attn: text("attn").notNull().default("ATTN: May Mahboob"),
  phone: text("phone").notNull().default(""),
  email: text("email").notNull().default("admin@archangelcontractors.com"),
  paymentInstructions: text("payment_instructions").notNull().default(""),
  taxRatePct: doublePrecision("tax_rate_pct").notNull().default(0),
  // Expenses at or above this amount require approval before posting to the
  // books. 0 disables the approval workflow.
  expenseApprovalThreshold: doublePrecision("expense_approval_threshold")
    .notNull()
    .default(0),
  // When true, HALO automatically emails the property contact a live job link
  // when a job is scheduled and again when it's completed.
  autoSendRecapLinks: boolean("auto_send_recap_links").notNull().default(true),
  // When true, the Autopilot background agent watches for overdue invoices,
  // stale crew offers, and aging unscheduled jobs and raises alerts.
  autopilotEnabled: boolean("autopilot_enabled").notNull().default(true),
  // When true, Autopilot executes its proposed actions (reminder emails,
  // rebroadcasts) immediately. When false, actions wait for one-tap approval.
  autopilotAutoApprove: boolean("autopilot_auto_approve").notNull().default(false),
  updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true })
    .notNull()
    .defaultNow(),
});

export type BusinessSettings = typeof businessSettingsTable.$inferSelect;

// Singleton row of saved Tax Planner inputs. Like business_settings, this is

  otherTaxableIncome: doublePrecision("other_taxable_income").notNull().default(0),
  aboveLineAdjustments: doublePrecision("above_line_adjustments").notNull().default(0),
  itemizedDeductions: doublePrecision("itemized_deductions").notNull().default(0),
  qbiDeduction: doublePrecision("qbi_deduction").notNull().default(0),
  taxCredits: doublePrecision("tax_credits").notNull().default(0),
  federalWithholding: doublePrecision("federal_withholding").notNull().default(0),
  estimatedPaymentsMade: doublePrecision("estimated_payments_made").notNull().default(0),
```

## 6. OpenAPI Specification


### `lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml` — Single source of truth for all API contracts

```yaml
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  # Do not change the title, if the title changes, the import paths will be broken
  title: Api
  version: 0.1.0
  description: HALO — Archangel Operations Layer API
servers:
  - url: /api
    description: Base API path
tags:
  - name: health
    description: Health operations
  - name: today
    description: Today feed, morning brief, computed queues
  - name: properties
    description: Properties, price lists, contacts, agreements
  - name: pipeline
    description: Leads and bids
  - name: jobs
    description: Jobs, schedules, crews
  - name: money
    description: Invoices, payments, expenses, money summary
  - name: inventory
    description: Inventory, vendors, purchase orders
  - name: activity
    description: Activities and notifications
  - name: voice
    description: Voice capture, parsing, and confirmation
  - name: ingest
    description: File upload and parsing
  - name: Storage
    description: File upload and object serving
  - name: crew-portal
    description: Admin-side crew portal, documents, payments
  - name: portal
    description: Public token-gated crew portal
  - name: accounting
    description: Double-entry ledger, journal, and financial reports
paths:
  /healthz:
    get:
      operationId: healthCheck
      tags: [health]
      summary: Health check
      description: Returns server health status
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/HealthStatus"

  /today:
    get:
      operationId: getToday
      tags: [today]
      summary: Today feed with triaged queues and morning brief
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Today payload
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/TodayPayload"

  /brief/refresh:
    post:
      operationId: refreshBrief
      tags: [today]
      summary: Regenerate the AI morning brief from live data
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Fresh brief
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Brief"

  /queues:
    get:
      operationId: getQueues
      tags: [today]
      summary: The eight computed operational queues
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Queue counts and items
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/Queue"

  /feed/dismiss:
    post:
      operationId: dismissFeedItem
      tags: [today]
      summary: Clear a Today feed item so it no longer appears
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/FeedDismissInput"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Dismissed

  /wings/quality/{id}/review:
    post:
      operationId: runWingsQualityReview
      tags: [wings]
      summary: Run the AI quality review for a submission now
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Reviewed submission
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsQualityItem"
        "404":
          description: Not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"

  /wings/quality/{id}/decision:
    post:
      operationId: decideWingsQuality
      tags: [wings]
      summary: Record a human quality decision (overrides AI)
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsQualityDecisionInput"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Updated submission
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsQualityItem"
        "404":
          description: Not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"

  /wings/overrides:
    get:
      operationId: listWingsOverrides
      tags: [wings]
      summary: Wingline override accruals
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Overrides
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsOverride" }

  /wings/reserve:
    get:
      operationId: getWingsReserve
      tags: [wings]
      summary: Guardian Reserve accounts and recent transactions
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Reserve summary
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsReserveSummary"

  /wings/eligibility/{jobId}:
    get:
      operationId: getWingsEligibility
      tags: [wings]
      summary: Live First Flight eligibility ranking for a job
      parameters:
        - name: jobId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Ranked candidates
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsCandidate" }
        "404":
          description: Not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"

  /wings/incidents:
    get:
      operationId: listWingsIncidents
      tags: [wings]
      summary: Quality/safety incidents
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Incidents
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsIncident" }
    post:
      operationId: createWingsIncident
      tags: [wings]
      summary: Log an incident (callback, rework, damage, complaint, safety)
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsIncidentInput"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Created incident
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsIncident"

  /wings/incidents/{id}/resolve:
    post:
      operationId: resolveWingsIncident
      tags: [wings]
      summary: Mark an incident resolved
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Resolved incident
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsIncident"
        "404":
          description: Not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"

  /wings/automation/run:
    post:
      operationId: runWingsAutomationNow
      tags: [wings]
      summary: Run the full Founding Wings automation sweep now
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Run result
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsAutomationRun"

  /wings/automation/runs:
    get:
      operationId: listWingsAutomationRuns
      tags: [wings]
      summary: Recent automation runs with results and the daily AI brief
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Runs
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsAutomationRun" }

  /wings/audit:
    get:
      operationId: listWingsAudit
      tags: [wings]
      summary: Founding Wings audit log
      parameters:
        - name: limit
          in: query
          required: false
          schema: { type: integer }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Audit entries
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsAuditEntry" }


  /portal/{token}/wings:
    get:
      operationId: getPortalWings
      tags: [wings]
      summary: Founding Wings status for a crew portal
      parameters:
        - name: token
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Wings status
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/PortalWings"
        "404":
          description: Invalid link
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"


components:
  schemas:
    HealthStatus:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
      required:
        - status
    Error:
      type: object
      properties:
        error:
          type: string
      required: [error]

    Brief:
      type: object
      required: [body, when, needsYou, generatedAt]
      properties:
        body: { type: string }
        when: { type: string }
        needsYou: { type: integer }
        generatedAt: { type: string }

    FeedCard:
      type: object
      required: [id, queue, tier, title, sub]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        queue: { type: string }
        tier: { type: string, description: "now | today | week | handled" }
        title: { type: string }
        sub: { type: string }
        entityType: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        entityId: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        amount: { type: ["number", "null"] }
        meta:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/CardChip"
        actions:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/CardAction"
    CardChip:
      type: object
      required: [label]
      properties:
        label: { type: string }
        mono: { type: ["boolean", "null"] }
        warn: { type: ["boolean", "null"] }
        gold: { type: ["boolean", "null"] }
    CardAction:
      type: object
      required: [label, action, kind]
      properties:
        label: { type: string }
        action: { type: string }
        kind: { type: string, description: "gold | ghost | line" }
    TodayPayload:
      type: object
      required: [date, brief, feed, queues, unreadNotifications]
      properties:
        date: { type: string }
        brief:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Brief"
        feed:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/FeedCard"
        queues:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Queue"
        unreadNotifications: { type: integer }
    Queue:
      type: object
      required: [key, label, count]
      properties:
        key: { type: string }
        label: { type: string }
        count: { type: integer }
        color: { type: ["string", "null"] }

    FeedDismissInput:
      type: object
      required: [itemId]
      properties:
        itemId: { type: string, minLength: 1 }

    AskInput:
      type: object
      required: [question]
      properties:
        question: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
    AskAnswer:
      type: object
      required: [answer]
      properties:
        answer: { type: string }

    Property:
      type: object
      required: [id, name, status]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        name: { type: string }
        pmcName: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        address: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        city: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        units: { type: ["integer", "null"] }
        accessNotes: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        imagePath: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        brief: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        briefUpdatedAt: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        avgDaysToPay: { type: ["number", "null"] }
        marginMin: { type: ["number", "null"], description: "Fraction, e.g. 0.25 = 25%" }
        marginTarget: { type: ["number", "null"], description: "Fraction, e.g. 0.35 = 35%" }
        status: { type: string }
        createdAt: { type: ["string", "null"] }
    PropertySummary:
      type: object
      required: [id, name, owed, openJobs]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        name: { type: string }
        pmcName: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        city: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        units: { type: ["integer", "null"] }
        owed: { type: number }
        openJobs: { type: integer }
        marginPct: { type: ["number", "null"] }
        imagePath: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        address: { type: ["string", "null"] }
    PropertyDetail:
      type: object
      required: [property, contacts, priceItems, jobs, expenses, agreements, invoices, upcomingVisits, stats]
      properties:
        property:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Property"
        contacts:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Contact"
        priceItems:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/PriceItem"
        jobs:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Job"
        expenses:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Expense"
        agreements:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Agreement"
        invoices:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Invoice"
        upcomingVisits:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/UpcomingVisit"
        stats:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/PropertyStats"
        crewPhotos:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/CrewJobPhoto"
    CrewJobPhoto:
      type: object
      required: [id, url, takenOn, jobId]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        url: { type: string, description: "Relative API path to the image, e.g. /api/storage/objects/..." }
        takenOn: { type: string }
        note: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        crewName: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        jobId: { type: string }
        jobNo: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        unitNo: { type: ["string", "null"] }
    UpcomingVisit:
      type: object
      required: [id, jobId, scheduledOn]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        jobId: { type: string }
        scheduledOn: { type: string }
        windowStart: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        crewLeaderName: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        jobDescription: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        unitNo: { type: ["string", "null"] }
    PropertyStats:
      type: object
      required: [owed, openJobs, marginPct, mtdRevenue, invoicedTotal, collectedTotal, expensesTotal, activeMarginPct, historicalMarginPct]
      properties:
        owed: { type: number }
        openJobs: { type: integer }
        marginPct: { type: ["number", "null"] }
        activeMarginPct: { type: ["number", "null"], description: "Percent (0-100) margin across active jobs, revenue-weighted" }
        historicalMarginPct: { type: ["number", "null"], description: "Percent (0-100) average margin of cleared/completed jobs" }
        mtdRevenue: { type: number }
        invoicedTotal: { type: number }
        collectedTotal: { type: number }
        expensesTotal: { type: number }
    PropertyInput:
      type: object
      required: [name]
      properties:
        name: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        pmcName: { type: string }
        address: { type: string }
        city: { type: string }
        units: { type: integer }
        accessNotes: { type: string }
        marginMin: { type: ["number", "null"], minimum: 0, maximum: 1 }
        marginTarget: { type: ["number", "null"], minimum: 0, maximum: 1 }
        latitude: { type: ["number", "null"], minimum: -90, maximum: 90 }
        longitude: { type: ["number", "null"], minimum: -180, maximum: 180 }
    PropertyUpdate:
      type: object
      properties:
        name: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        pmcName: { type: string }
        address: { type: string }
        city: { type: string }
        units: { type: integer }
        accessNotes: { type: string }
        brief: { type: string }
        marginMin: { type: ["number", "null"], minimum: 0, maximum: 1 }
        marginTarget: { type: ["number", "null"], minimum: 0, maximum: 1 }
        status: { type: string }

    Contact:
      type: object
      required: [id, name]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        propertyId: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        name: { type: string }
        role: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        phone: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        email: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        prefers: { type: ["string", "null"] }
    ContactInput:
      type: object
      required: [name]
      properties:
        propertyId: { type: string }
        name: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        role: { type: string }
        phone: { type: string }
        email: { type: string }
        prefers: { type: string }
    ContactUpdate:
      type: object
      properties:
        name: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        role: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        phone: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        email: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        prefers: { type: ["string", "null"] }

    PriceItem:
      type: object
      required: [id, propertyId, service, rate]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        propertyId: { type: string }
        service: { type: string }
        detail: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        unit: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        rate: { type: number }
        marginFloor: { type: ["number", "null"] }
    PriceItemInput:
      type: object
      required: [service, rate]
      properties:
        service: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        detail: { type: string }
        unit: { type: string }
        rate: { type: number }
        marginFloor: { type: number }
    PriceItemUpdate:
      type: object
      properties:
        service: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        detail: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        unit: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        rate: { type: number }
        marginFloor: { type: ["number", "null"] }

    CatalogItem:
      type: object
      required: [id, service]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        service: { type: string }
        detail: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        unit: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        rate: { type: ["number", "null"] }
        category: { type: ["string", "null"] }
    CatalogItemInput:
      type: object
      required: [service]
      properties:
        service: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        detail: { type: string }
        unit: { type: string }
        rate: { type: number }
        category: { type: string }
    CatalogItemUpdate:
      type: object
      properties:
        service: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        detail: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        unit: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        rate: { type: ["number", "null"] }
        category: { type: ["string", "null"] }
    PriceItemImportInput:
      type: object
      required: [catalogItemIds]
      properties:
        catalogItemIds:
          type: array
          items: { type: string }
          minItems: 1
    PriceItemImportResult:
      type: object
      required: [imported, skipped]
      properties:
        imported:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/PriceItem"
        skipped:
          type: integer

    Agreement:
      type: object
      required: [id, title]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        propertyId: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        title: { type: string }
        storagePath: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        effectiveFrom: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        renewsOn: { type: ["string", "null"] }

    Lead:
      type: object
      required: [id, status]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        propertyId: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        propertyName: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        source: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        summary: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        status: { type: string }
        contactName: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        contactEmail: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        contactPhone: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        callTranscript: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        lastContactAt: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        campaignKind: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        campaignStatus: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        campaignStepIndex: { type: ["number", "null"] }
        campaignNextSendAt: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        createdAt: { type: ["string", "null"] }
    LeadInput:
      type: object
      required: [summary]
      properties:
        propertyId: { type: string }
        source: { type: string }
        summary: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        contactName: { type: string }
        contactEmail: { type: string }
        contactPhone: { type: string }
    LeadUpdate:
      type: object
      properties:
        status: { type: string }
        summary: { type: string }
        source: { type: string }
        contactName: { type: string }
        contactEmail: { type: string }
        contactPhone: { type: string }
    LeadEmailTemplate:
      type: object
      required: [key, name, subject, body]
      properties:
        key: { type: string }
        name: { type: string }
        description: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        subject: { type: string }
        body: { type: string }
    LeadEmailSendInput:
      type: object
      required: [templateKey]
      properties:
        templateKey: { type: string }
        to: { type: string }
    LeadEmailSendResult:
      type: object
      required: [sent]
      properties:
        sent: { type: boolean }
        to: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        error: { type: ["string", "null"] }
    LeadCampaignDef:
      type: object
      required: [kind, name, steps]
      properties:
        kind: { type: string }
        name: { type: string }
        description: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        steps:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required: [dayOffset, templateKey, templateName]
            properties:
              dayOffset: { type: number }
              templateKey: { type: string }
              templateName: { type: string }
    LeadCampaignStartInput:
      type: object
      required: [kind]
      properties:
        kind: { type: string }

    Bid:
      type: object
      required: [id, bidNo, amount, status]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        bidNo: { type: string }
        propertyId: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        propertyName: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        unitNo: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        scope: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        welcomeMessage: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        amount: { type: number }
        estCost: { type: ["number", "null"] }
        status: { type: string }
        sentAt: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        decidedAt: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        lastNudgeAt: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        createdAt: { type: ["string", "null"] }
    BidLineItem:
      type: object
      required: [id, service, qty, unitPrice, amount]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        service: { type: string }
        description: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        qty: { type: number }
        unitPrice: { type: number }
        amount: { type: number }
        sortOrder: { type: ["number", "null"] }
    BidLineItemInput:
      type: object
      required: [service, qty, unitPrice]
      properties:
        service: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        description: { type: string }
        qty: { type: number }
        unitPrice: { type: number }
    BidDetail:
      allOf:
        - $ref: "#/components/schemas/Bid"
        - type: object
          required: [lineItems]
          properties:
            propertyAddress: { type: ["string", "null"] }
            propertyCity: { type: ["string", "null"] }
            contactName: { type: ["string", "null"] }
            contactEmail: { type: ["string", "null"] }
            lineItems:
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/BidLineItem"
    BidInput:
      type: object
      required: [scope, amount]
      properties:
        propertyId: { type: string }
        unitNo: { type: string }
        scope: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        welcomeMessage: { type: string }
        amount: { type: number }
        estCost: { type: number }
        status: { type: string }
        lineItems:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/BidLineItemInput"
    BidUpdate:
      type: object
      properties:
        scope: { type: string }
        welcomeMessage: { type: string }
        unitNo: { type: string }
        amount: { type: number }
        estCost: { type: number }
        status: { type: string }
        lineItems:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/BidLineItemInput"
    BidSendInput:
      type: object
      properties:
        to: { type: string }
        message: { type: string }
    BidSendResult:
      type: object
      required: [sent]
      properties:
        sent: { type: boolean }
        to: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        error: { type: ["string", "null"] }

    Job:
      type: object
      required: [id, jobNo, status]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        jobNo: { type: string }
        woNo: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        propertyId: { type: string }
        propertyName: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        unitNo: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        category: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        description: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        status: { type: string }
        crewLeaderId: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        crewLeaderName: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        bidId: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        contactId: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        inspectionRequired: { type: ["boolean", "null"] }
        inspectionPassedAt: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        completedAt: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        clearedAt: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        recapSentAt: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        warrantyUntil: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        scheduledOn: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        scheduledTime: { type: ["string", "null"], description: "HH:MM start time for fixed-schedule jobs" }
        grossProfit: { type: ["number", "null"] }
        marginPct: { type: ["number", "null"] }
        crewRate: { type: ["number", "null"], description: "Payout rate the crew must accept for this job" }
        invoicedTotal: { type: ["number", "null"], description: "Sum of non-draft invoices attached to this job (property detail only)" }
        paidTotal: { type: ["number", "null"], description: "Sum of paid invoices attached to this job (property detail only)" }
        expensesTotal: { type: ["number", "null"], description: "Sum of expenses attached to this job (property detail only)" }
        boardStatus: { type: ["string", "null"], description: "active | filled | reopened | completed" }
        scheduleType: { type: ["string", "null"], description: "scheduled (crew commits to set days/hours) | flex (crew works on own time before flexDueBy)" }
        flexDueBy: { type: ["string", "null"], description: "YYYY-MM-DD deadline for flex jobs, set at broadcast time" }
        crewsNeeded: { type: ["number", "null"], description: "Crew slots for this broadcasted job" }
        crewsFilled: { type: ["number", "null"], description: "Approved crew count so far" }
        nextVisitOn: { type: ["string", "null"], description: "Next scheduled visit date (YYYY-MM-DD, property detail only)" }
        crewPaymentStatus: { type: ["string", "null"], description: "paid | pending | null when no crew payment recorded (property detail only)" }
        crewPaidAt: { type: ["string", "null"], description: "When the crew payment was completed (property detail only)" }
        isRecurring: { type: ["boolean", "null"] }
        recurrence: { type: ["string", "null"], description: "daily | weekly | biweekly | monthly | quarterly" }
        createdAt: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        lineItems:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/JobLineItem"
        lineTotal: { type: ["number", "null"] }
    CloseOutJobResult:
      type: object

        dateOfWork:
          { type: string, pattern: '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$', description: "YYYY-MM-DD" }
        unitNo: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        typeOfWork: { type: string }
        qty: { type: number }
        unitPrice: { type: number }

      type: object
      required: [action]
      properties:
        action:
          type: string
          enum: [approve, send_back, mark_paid, clear]
        note:
          type: ["string", "null"]
          description: "Required for send_back — what the crew must fix"
    CrewInvoiceInput:
      type: object
      required:
        [fromCompany, propertyAddress, invoiceDate, items, signatureName]
      properties:
        fromCompany: { type: string }
        fromTrade: { type: ["string", "null"] }

        fromCityStateZip: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        fromContact: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        fromPhone: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        fromEmail: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        invoiceNo: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        poNumber: { type: ["string", "null"] }

          { type: string, pattern: '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$', description: "YYYY-MM-DD" }
        terms: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        dueDate:
          { type: ["string", "null"], pattern: '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' }
        propertyAddress: { type: string }
        jobId:
          type: ["string", "null"]
          description: "Optional job this invoice is for; must be assigned to this crew. Server derives propertyId from it."
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/CrewInvoiceItemInput"
        signatureName: { type: string }
    CrewInvoiceItem:
      type: object
      required: [id, dateOfWork, typeOfWork, qty, unitPrice, amount]
      properties:

        unitNo: { type: ["string", "null"] }
        typeOfWork: { type: string }
        qty: { type: number }
        unitPrice: { type: number }
        amount: { type: number }
    CrewInvoice:

        dueDate: { type: ["string", "null"] }

        partnershipSEIncomePercent: { type: number }

          enum: [sole_proprietor, single_member_llc, partnership, s_corp, c_corp]

          type: string

        ownershipPercent: { type: number }

        aboveLineAdjustments: { type: number }
        itemizedDeductions: { type: number }

        isAvailable: { type: boolean }
        maxConcurrentJobs: { type: number }
        draftTokens: { type: number }
    WingsQualityReview:
      type: object
      required: [status, finalScore, confidence, criticalConcern, summary, decidedBy]
      properties:
        status: { type: string }
        finalScore: { type: number }
        completenessScore: { type: number }
        craftsmanshipScore: { type: number }
        propertyProtectionScore: { type: number }
        safetyScore: { type: number }
        anomalyRisk: { type: number }
        confidence: { type: number }
        criticalConcern: { type: boolean }
        summary: { type: string }
        concerns:
          type: array
          items: { type: string }
        decidedBy: { type: string }
        reviewedAt: { type: string, nullable: true }
    WingsQualityItem:
      type: object
      required: [id, jobId, reviewStatus, submittedAt, beforeCount, afterCount]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }

        jobNo: { type: string, nullable: true }
        jobCategory: { type: string, nullable: true }
        propertyName: { type: string, nullable: true }

        crewName: { type: string, nullable: true }
        reviewStatus: { type: string }
        notes: { type: string, nullable: true }
        beforeCount: { type: number }
        afterCount: { type: number }
        submittedAt: { type: string }
        review:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsQualityReview"
          nullable: true
    WingsQualityDecisionInput:
      type: object
      required: [status, reason]
      properties:
        status: { type: string, enum: [PASS, FAIL, NEEDS_REVIEW] }
        reason: { type: string }
        finalScore: { type: number }
    WingsOverride:
      type: object
      required: [id, jobId, sponsorCrewId, recruitCrewId, grossOverride, immediateAmount, reserveAmount, status, immediateStatus, createdAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        jobId: { type: string }
        jobNo: { type: string, nullable: true }
        sponsorCrewId: { type: string }
        sponsorName: { type: string, nullable: true }
        recruitCrewId: { type: string }
        recruitName: { type: string, nullable: true }
        allocatedGrossProfit: { type: number }
        baseRate: { type: number }
        qualityMultiplier: { type: number }
        grossOverride: { type: number }
        immediateAmount: { type: number }
        reserveAmount: { type: number }
        reserveBonus: { type: number, nullable: true }
        reserveDebit: { type: number, nullable: true }
        status: { type: string }
        immediateStatus: { type: string }
        qualityWindowEndsAt: { type: string, nullable: true }
        reserveReleasedAt: { type: string, nullable: true }
        createdAt: { type: string }
    WingsReserveAccount:
      type: object
      required: [id, crewId, heldBalance, releasedBalance, debitedBalance]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        crewId: { type: string }
        crewName: { type: string, nullable: true }
        heldBalance: { type: number }
        releasedBalance: { type: number }
        debitedBalance: { type: number }
    WingsReserveTxn:
      type: object
      required: [id, crewId, type, amount, createdAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        crewId: { type: string }
        crewName: { type: string, nullable: true }
        overrideId: { type: string, nullable: true }
        type: { type: string }
        amount: { type: number }
        note: { type: string, nullable: true }
        createdAt: { type: string }
    WingsReserveSummary:
      type: object
      required: [accounts, transactions, totals]
      properties:
        accounts:
          type: array
          items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsReserveAccount" }
        transactions:
          type: array
          items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsReserveTxn" }
        totals:
          type: object
          required: [held, released, debited]
          properties:
            held: { type: number }
            released: { type: number }
            debited: { type: number }
    WingsCandidate:
      type: object
      required: [crewId, crewName, eligible, rankScore, haloScore, tier, founderStatus, reasons]
      properties:
        crewId: { type: string }
        crewName: { type: string }
        eligible: { type: boolean }
        rankScore: { type: number }
        haloScore: { type: number }
        tier: { type: string }
        founderStatus: { type: string }
        reasons:
          type: array
          items: { type: string }
    WingsIncident:
      type: object
      required: [id, type, severity, description, occurredAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        jobId: { type: string, nullable: true }
        jobNo: { type: string, nullable: true }
        crewId: { type: string, nullable: true }
        crewName: { type: string, nullable: true }
        type: { type: string }
        severity: { type: number }
        description: { type: string }
        cost: { type: number, nullable: true }
        occurredAt: { type: string }
        resolvedAt: { type: string, nullable: true }
    WingsIncidentInput:
      type: object
      required: [type, description]
      properties:
        jobId: { type: string, nullable: true }
        crewId: { type: string, nullable: true }
        type: { type: string, enum: [CALLBACK, REWORK, DAMAGE, CUSTOMER_COMPLAINT, SAFETY, OTHER] }
        severity: { type: number }
        description: { type: string }
        cost: { type: number, nullable: true }
    WingsAutomationRun:
      type: object
      required: [id, kind, status, actionsRun, startedAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        kind: { type: string }
        status: { type: string }
        actionsRun: { type: number }
        result:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
          nullable: true
        error: { type: string, nullable: true }
        startedAt: { type: string }
        completedAt: { type: string, nullable: true }
    WingsAuditEntry:
      type: object
      required: [id, actorType, action, entityType, createdAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        actorType: { type: string }
        action: { type: string }
        entityType: { type: string }
        entityId: { type: string, nullable: true }
        before:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
          nullable: true
        after:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
          nullable: true
        reason: { type: string, nullable: true }
        createdAt: { type: string }
    WingsOverview:
      type: object
      required: [members, pendingReviews, needsHumanReview, heldReserve, releasedReserve, readyOverrides, overrideTotal, lastRun, tierCounts]
      properties:
        members: { type: number }
        pendingMembers: { type: number }
        pendingReviews: { type: number }
        needsHumanReview: { type: number }
        heldReserve: { type: number }
        releasedReserve: { type: number }
        readyOverrides: { type: number }
        overrideTotal: { type: number }
        openIncidents: { type: number }
        lastRun:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsAutomationRun"
          nullable: true
        tierCounts:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: { type: number }

    PortalWings:
      type: object
      required: [haloScore, tier, founderStatus, scoreConfidence, recruits, overrides, reserve]
      properties:
        haloScore: { type: number }
        tier: { type: string }
        membershipStatus: { type: string }
        founderStatus: { type: string }
        founderNumber: { type: number, nullable: true }
        scoreConfidence: { type: number }
        scoreUpdatedAt: { type: string, nullable: true }
        scoreReasons:
          type: array
          items: { type: string }
          nullable: true
        sponsorName: { type: string, nullable: true }
        recruits:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required: [crewName, tier, haloScore]
            properties:
              crewName: { type: string }
              tier: { type: string }
              haloScore: { type: number }
        overrides:
          type: array
          items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/WingsOverride" }
        reserve:
          type: object
          required: [held, released, debited]
          properties:
            held: { type: number }
            released: { type: number }
            debited: { type: number }
```


## 7. Shared Packet Library


### `lib/onboarding-packet/src/index.ts`

```typescript
export * from "./types";
export * from "./packets";
```


### `lib/onboarding-packet/src/packets.ts`

```typescript
import type {
  Locale,
  NetTerms,
  PacketForm,
  PacketTemplate,
  IntakeQuestion,
} from "./types";

export const COMPANY = {
  name: "ArchAngel Contractors",
  email: "admin@archangelcontractors.com",
  warrantyMonths: 12,
  terminationNoticeDays: 30,
  venue: "Collin County, Texas",
} as const;

/** All form codes that carry a bundled source legal PDF (per locale). */
export const SOURCE_PDF_CODES = [
  "00",
  "01",
  "A",
  "B",
  "B-1",
  "L-ALT",
  "L",
  "N",
  "N-1",
  "C",
  "D",
  "E",
  "M",
  "F-1",
  "F-2",
  "H",
  "K",
  "J",
  "O",
  "P",
] as const;

function tr(locale: Locale, en: string, es: string): string {
  return locale === "es" ? es : en;
}

function buildForms(locale: Locale, netTerms: NetTerms = "non-net30"): PacketForm[] {
  const net30 = netTerms === "net30";
  const t = (en: string, es: string) => tr(locale, en, es);

  const agree = t(
    "I have read, understand, and agree to this document.",
    "He leído, entiendo y acepto este documento.",
  );
  const subRole = t("Subcontractor", "Subcontratista");

  const sub = (agreeText?: string) => ({
    key: "sub",
    roleLabel: subRole,
    captureTitle: true,
    captureCompany: true,
    agreeText: agreeText ?? agree,

    {
      code: "00",
```
